wishes: Planner defaults (Pavel gave only the genre and title): warm, cosy, playful city romance; family-friendly (no alcohol, no kissing figures); hearts as the recurring motif; no text on letters, signs or tags.

variants.concept: First Date: classic date props and the city spots where it happens

cards.name: Rose Bouquet
cards.subject: a bouquet of three red roses wrapped in soft pink paper and tied with a satin ribbon bow
cards.unique_detail: a small blank heart-shaped tag hanging from the ribbon
cards.main_colors: warm red roses, soft pink wrapping, white ribbon
cards.background: bright sunny yellow with clearly visible radiating rays
cards.why: The classic rom-com gift; reads as romance instantly.

cards.name: Rotary Phone
cards.subject: a vintage red rotary telephone with a coiled cord and its handset resting on top
cards.unique_detail: a tiny heart in the centre of the dial
cards.background: a polished wooden side table in front of a smooth purple wall
cards.why: Waiting for the call is a genre staple.

cards.name: City Taxi
cards.subject: a classic yellow city taxi cab with a blank white roof sign
cards.unique_detail: a black-and-white checker stripe along the side and a small red heart sticker on the door
cards.background: a strip of city street at the bottom with a white crosswalk, bright blue sky with soft clouds and a hint of rooftops low on the horizon
cards.why: The ride across the big city to the meet-cute.

cards.name: Heart Cupcake
cards.subject: a cupcake with swirled pink frosting in a red-and-white paper case
cards.unique_detail: a glossy red heart-shaped candy on top
cards.main_colors: pink frosting, red heart, red-and-white case
cards.background: a plain warm orange surface in front of a smooth orange gradient wall
cards.why: A sweet treat shared on the first date.

cards.name: Heart Chocolates
cards.subject: a red heart-shaped chocolate box with its lid tilted open, showing a few round chocolates
cards.unique_detail: a big gold satin bow on the lid
cards.main_colors: warm red box, gold bow, brown chocolates
cards.background: fresh green with concentric rings centred behind the box
cards.why: Valentine gift; the red heart is the genre's symbol.

cards.name: Park Bench
cards.subject: a curved wooden park bench with black wrought-iron arms under a blossoming pink cherry tree
cards.unique_detail: a few pink petals resting on the seat
cards.main_colors: warm brown wood, black iron, pink blossom
cards.background: a strip of green lawn at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: The park bench where the couple meets.

cards.name: Record Player
cards.subject: a vintage suitcase record player in cream with its lid open
cards.unique_detail: a red heart-shaped vinyl record on the turntable
cards.background: a polished wooden dresser top in front of a smooth warm pink wall
cards.why: Their song; the slow dance at home.

cards.name: Love Letter
cards.subject: a pink envelope sealed with a red heart-shaped wax seal, floating at a slight tilt
cards.unique_detail: a small pressed flower tucked under the flap
cards.background: warm yellow with a subtle pattern of small hearts
cards.why: The love letter drives the plot.

cards.name: Perfume
cards.subject: a round faceted pink glass perfume bottle with a gold atomizer bulb
cards.unique_detail: a short pink tassel hanging from the bulb
cards.background: a plain green surface in front of a smooth green gradient wall
cards.why: Getting ready for the big date.

cards.name: Flower Kiosk
cards.subject: a small flower kiosk cart with a striped red-and-white awning, full of buckets of colourful flowers
cards.unique_detail: a heart-shaped wreath hanging on the front
cards.background: a strip of city sidewalk at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: Where the bouquet is bought; city romance.

cards.name: Red Umbrella
cards.subject: an open classic red umbrella with a curved wooden handle, tilted
cards.unique_detail: a little heart-shaped charm dangling from the handle
cards.background: bright blue with radiating rays
cards.why: Sharing an umbrella in the rain.

cards.name: Typewriter
cards.subject: a vintage typewriter in mint green and cream with a blank sheet of paper
cards.unique_detail: a small pink heart doodle on the blank sheet
cards.background: a polished wooden desk in front of a smooth warm orange wall
cards.why: The writer heroine typing her love story.

cards.name: Vintage Scooter
cards.subject: a vintage scooter in warm red and cream with a round headlight
cards.unique_detail: a wicker basket of flowers on the back rack
cards.background: a strip of cobblestone street at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: A romantic ride through the old town.

cards.name: Heart Balloon
cards.subject: a smooth, glossy red heart-shaped foil balloon with a white ribbon string that hangs down with one soft curl
cards.unique_detail: a tiny pink bow where the ribbon meets the balloon
cards.background: sunny yellow with concentric rings centred behind the balloon
cards.why: A playful surprise gift.

cards.name: Matching Mugs

cards.name: Engagement Ring

cards.background: rich purple with concentric rings centred behind the ring

cards.name: Tulip Bucket

cards.name: Heart Glasses
cards.subject: a pair of red heart-shaped sunglasses

cards.background: a plain warm orange surface in front of a smooth orange gradient wall
